requirement: Site notes are kept by the host beside the step, only from what the customer typed, per site, outside the folder the agent's file tools reach

oracle.ref: PR #1026 (feat); fix evidence: Measured 08/10/2026 on DeepSeek (81 runs): with a tracy_notes tool in the agent's loop, the conversation in which the customer states a wish cost +55% output tokens, +67% reasoning and +4 tool calls; the tool was removed and the host keeps the notes with one side call. Found while writing the wiring test: with the notes inside the site folder, a model with the 'write' tool could forge a note line and be sent it as 'what the customer asked' in every later conversation; the store was moved out of the folder.
oracle.invariant: Every named test reports ok and the run exits 0 with nothing failed, cancelled or skipped. The agent is given no notes tool: its tools are tracy_site, tracy_design_check and tracy_emdash, as before the feature. Only a customer message (never a notice, a tool answer or a model's words) that carries the marks of a lasting wish starts one side call, and the step never waits for it. A proposal of the side call is kept only when it quotes the message the customer typed, with the page text of a Browser-tab comment cut out; a removal needs the customer asking for it in their own words; a model that is down, stalls or answers junk keeps nothing and never throws. A note line the agent writes by hand into the site folder is NOT a note: what a later conversation is sent comes only from the host's store <sitesRoot>/.site-notes/<label>, outside <sitesRoot>/<label>, the only folder the file tools are fenced to. One site's notes are never sent to another site's conversation, and a site without notes is sent no notice at all. The notes are capped at 24 notes and 2,000 characters in total.
